scope:
Compile and execute an in-memory-only dispatch/entry observer prototype.

No kernel file, boot package, hardware command, native policy or APFS body is
replaced on disk. Real VNOP_READ and callback first instruction execute; APIs
and callback remainder are explicit models, not filesystem qualification.

A037.value: pinned regular-read entry PC, zero until observed

limitations: Only pinned regular-read entry is observed; a different A036 target does not imply that target failed to enter
Native VNOP wrapper and first callback instruction execute; callback remainder and uio API are modeled
Extra framebuffer rows through831 require full integration/mapping/exception/package qualification before any device use
Signed negative index is a synthetic corruption control, not a valid runtime configuration
